facts.claim: On a fresh checkout (f4fb5aa16441ba7aac94b22770d74feb36240943 plus RIR input integration), the host-addon-only native build script for native/system exits successfully on Windows but does not build the package's JavaScript entry. Node's resolver therefore cannot satisfy the bare import '@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/flock' from packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/lease.ts, so dependent suites fail at import time. Running pnpm -C native/system run build:ts created the entry and focused verification then passed 34 tests.
assumptions: The failure is a build-artifact/orchestration gap rather than a flock runtime or API defect; the import-time (not call-time) failure signature and the successful post-build:ts run support this.
The observed script scope behavior may be platform-conditional to Windows; generalization to Linux/macOS CI is not established.
uncertainties: Frequency of this setup failure on fresh checkouts is unknown.
Whether an existing documented aggregate/full-package build command for native/system already includes build:ts is unverified; if one exists this is a usage gap, not a tooling gap.
Blast radius beyond packages that transitively import the flock addon was not measured.
